jobs.title: Remote Engineering Manager (Algorithms Team) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As an Engineering Manager for the Algorithms team (Revenue Management Engine) at RoomPriceGenie, you will build and lead the team behind the core of our product: the pricing and forecasting engine that automatically prices rooms for thousands of hotels. This is the algorithmic and data heart of RoomPriceGenie, spanning the pricing algorithm, the forecasting models and the data pipelines that feed them.

This is a leadership role. Your focus is the team: delivery, people and the connection to product goals. You stay technically credible and close to the work through design and code review, and you get hands-on when the team needs it, but you are not coding day to day. You balance delivery speed with long-term technical health and build an environment of trust and accountability. The role also reaches beyond your own team: we want you leading the way on technical improvements at the Product and Engineering department level, things like engineering processes and operational excellence, as a hands-on driver.

You will work closely with a Product Manager and report to the Senior Engineering Manager. A core part of the job is turning a complex, data-heavy domain into reliable, measurable outcomes: shipping model and pipeline improvements, proving their impact through backtesting and clear quality metrics, and keeping pricing runs dependable at scale. We expect you to be a genuine partner to Product, able to challenge and shape what gets built, not only how.

Who you'll lead

You will lead a team of 4 engineers (3 Senior and 1 Staff). The role may also grow to include an Associate Engineering Manager over time.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing team across the pricing algorithm, forecasting and data pipelines, owning delivery, quality and the operational health of pricing runs.

  • Grow your people through regular 1:1s, feedback, performance reviews and career development.

  • Hire, onboard and develop engineers to keep the team balanced and strong.

  • Partner closely with Product and challenge them: push back on direction, bring your own point of view and drive changes to what the team builds, not just how it builds.

  • Translate business goals into clear engineering plans with measurable outcomes and realistic timelines. Use data (backtesting, model quality, before and after signals) to guide prioritisation.

  • Balance delivery velocity with technical sustainability, addressing debt, scalability and reliability as part of delivery rather than after it.

  • Provide technical oversight through design and code review, staying close enough to guide architecture and quality and to get hands-on when the team genuinely needs it.

  • Act as a buffer between the team and external pressure, keeping focus and healthy team dynamics.

  • Improve engineering processes and practices to increase clarity, alignment and predictable delivery.

  • Lead technical improvements beyond your own team, at the Product and Engineering department level, for example engineering processes and operational excellence. We want you hands-on and driving these, not only sponsoring them.

Your Profile

  • Strong software engineering background with a track record of building and operating production systems, ideally with depth in backend and data-intensive or algorithmic domains.

  • At least 5 years of experience, with several years genuinely managing engineers, including performance management. This is a role for an experienced manager, not a first step into leadership.

  • Experience growing or managing other managers, for example an Associate Engineering Manager or Team Leads, is a plus.

  • A strong product mindset with the confidence to challenge Product. You enjoy defining problems and validating solutions with PMs and you are comfortable disagreeing, proposing alternatives and driving them to a decision.

  • Technically credible and willing to get hands-on when the team needs it, while spending most of your time leading rather than in the code day to day.

  • Comfortable with our stack: Python/Django on the backend, with a data stack around Snowflake, dbt and Dagster. Exposure to forecasting, modelling or data engineering is a strong plus.

  • Strong grasp of system design, architecture and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication and leadership: you create clarity, trust and accountability, with a servant-leadership mindset toward your team.

  • You look beyond your own team and enjoy driving technical improvements that raise the bar across the wider Product and Engineering org.

  • Fluent in English and based in a European time zone (UTC+0 to UTC+2).

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. As our next Engineering Manager for Identity, you’ll lead the team that builds and delivers the Identity and Access Management (IAM) foundation that powers the entire Camunda 8 platform, both on-premise and as part of our SaaS offering. This is a key role which can have a deep impact on Camunda’s success, offering you the chance to have a direct impact on the company’s growth.

As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

What You Will Do:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of reusable IAM components across the Camunda 8 stack—shaping authentication (multi‑protocol), authorization (RBAC), and federated organization management that work seamlessly for large, integration‑heavy enterprises.

  • Partner closely with multiple engineering teams, SREs, QA, and the Product Leadership Team to develop and drive a clear technical and product vision; transparently steward the roadmap and track commitments from support, incidents, and the product backlog.

  • Raise the bar on reliability and efficiency: keep build/release pipelines low‑effort and stable, ship security fixes within SLOs, and drive down support load, bug count, and incident rate.

  • Grow and coach a team of senior and developing engineers—setting clear expectations, giving actionable feedback, and creating a culture of autonomy, accountability, and continuous improvement, especially in an asynchronous, remote environment aligned to the DRI model.

  • Help mature our SaaS offering for large scale enterprise customers, ensuring it can easily integrate with our customer’s own IAM solutions in a safe, reliable way.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • Senior‑level technical depth in IAM and enterprise software: you can review designs, ask the right questions, and represent your team to technical and non‑technical stakeholders with clarity.

  • Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting.

  • Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes.

  • Background in product engineering for integration‑heavy B2B products (not primarily consulting), with a deep appreciation for enterprise needs around security, operability, and performance.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem.

  • Experience implementing IAM federation.

  • Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications.

  • Experience with L3 support/incident management.

  • Experience working in a fully remote organization.

Du hast bei KPMG, BCG, McKinsey, Bain oder einer vergleichbaren Beratung gelernt, wie man auf Vorstandsebene überzeugt, komplexe Transformationen strukturiert und unter Druck liefert.

Kein Bonus-Pool, keine Politik – dein Ergebnis, deine Beteiligung.

Wir sind kein Konzern. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team, das im Bildungssektor bereits über 100 Träger jährlich betreut – Mandate, die von etablierten Bildungsträgern mit mehreren Standorten über wachsende Mittelständler bis hin zu Konzernmandaten reichen. Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

About Northwave

Defending the digital frontier is our mission.
At Northwave, 275 cybersecurity specialists transform how organisations approach digital safety. From our HQ in Utrecht, our DACH HQ in Leipzig and offices in Austria, Sweden, and Belgium.
Northwave combines ethical hacking expertise with behavioral psychology insights and cutting-edge security management at the highest level. We respond to threats and anticipate them, providing 24/7 managed security services and tailored solutions for each client's journey.
By joining Northwave, you’ll become part of an organisation where innovation drives results, whether your talents lie in technical penetration testing or strategic client partnerships. Here, your expertise will grow and help shape the future of digital security across industries, leaving a lasting impact.

Your Mission

As a Senior Business Security Consultant, you act as a strategic advisor and trusted partner for our clients. You help organizations navigate their digital transformation in a secure, resilient, and sustainable way. By connecting business objectives with cybersecurity challenges, you translate regulatory requirements and evolving threat landscapes into practical strategies that create measurable business value.

Drawing on your experience, you quickly understand complex organizational structures, identify both risks and opportunities, and engage with senior decision-makers as a trusted sparring partner. You take ownership of challenging client engagements, lead projects independently from initial concept through successful delivery, and ensure that recommendations are not only designed but also effectively embedded within the organization.

Your projects cover a broad range of topics, including security strategy, risk management, compliance frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001, as well as Northwave's comprehensive Managed Security Services. In this role, you work with mid-sized and large organizations across the DACH region, supporting them in their cybersecurity and business transformation initiatives.

As a Senior Consultant, you bring together Northwave's various areas of expertise. You coordinate collaboration between technical, behavioral, and incident response teams, provide functional leadership within multidisciplinary project teams, and ensure that individual measures are integrated into coherent and effective security programs.

In addition, you actively contribute to the growth and development of our consulting business. You identify emerging client needs, participate in sales and business development activities, and leverage your expertise to expand our service portfolio. At the same time, you mentor and support colleagues, foster knowledge sharing, and help strengthen the capabilities of the consulting team as a whole.

What You Enjoy

  • Analyzing complex business models, industry-specific requirements, and organizational challenges, and translating these insights into tailored security strategies.

  • Leading and successfully delivering large-scale, complex consulting and transformation projects with a high degree of ownership and accountability.

  • Translating evolving threat landscapes and regulatory frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001 into practical and actionable strategic roadmaps.

  • Advising and challenging executive leadership teams, board members, and other senior stakeholders on cybersecurity-related decisions.

  • Identifying business opportunities and actively contributing to sales, proposal development, and business development activities.

  • Collaborating with interdisciplinary experts to design innovative and effective security solutions for our clients.

  • Continuously expanding your cybersecurity expertise and contributing to the strategic direction and development of our consulting practice.

  • A mobility budget, also for private use, makes trips to your customers easier. Of course, we also pay travelling allowances.

  • What do you want to achieve and what support do you need? You will receive regular training and support in achieving your professional goals. You can also develop further within Northwave.

  • It is important to us to respect and value each other - as professionals and as people. The best way to get to know your 275+ colleagues from the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Belgium and Sweden is to take part in one of our many activities, such as a trip to the theme park.

  • You will be equipped with a modern MacBook and iPhone. We have height-adjustable desks in our offices and our CEO loves to kit us out with merchandise ;-)

what else...

No, the fruit basket in the office is not a benefit for us, but a matter of course - just like coffee, tea and lemonade. Have you ever tried Dutch caramel waffles?

  • Leadership & Mentoring: You enjoy sharing knowledge, coaching colleagues, and contributing to the development of high-performing consulting teams.

jobs.title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
New Challenge

About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. 

You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. 

The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.

What you'll do
Core engine development

  • Design and build the systems that power Hydris.
  • Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.
  • Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously.
Protocol and integration architecture
  • Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.
  • Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.
  • Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.
  • Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.
  • Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris.
Distributed systems
  • Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
  • Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.
  • Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.
Technical leadership
  • Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.
  • Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.
  • Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.

You should apply if you
  • Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.
  • Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.
  • Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.
  • Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale.
  • Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems.
  • Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. 
  • Working language is English. German is not required.
You'd be a great fit with
  • Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management.
  • Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525.
  • Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments.
  • Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation.

We Offer
  • Remote work anywhere in Germany, or hybrid/on-site in Berlin or Munich if you're already based there and prefer an office.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.
Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

About Us
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.

As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. 

You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.

What you'll do
Discovery and requirements

  • Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
  • Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
Roadmap and delivery
  • Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
  • Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.
  • Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
Systems and interoperability
  • Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols.
  • Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field.
  • Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them.
Collaboration

  • Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design.

Structural

At Feather, we're building insurance that actually matters to our customers. It rests on three principles: a fully digital experience, modern and flexible plans, and reliable human support. And because we build it all for expats living abroad, we're a genuinely different kind of insurer.

About the Team

OpenAI’s Legal team supports OpenAI’s mission by addressing complex legal issues arising from the development and deployment of AI. We’re seeking an experienced, hands-on lawyer to serve as our country lawyer for France, providing broad legal support for our local office with a primary focus on regulatory and policy legal matters affecting OpenAI’s products, operations and business.

You will advise on French and EU regulatory developments, develop practical legal positions and recommendations, and support OpenAI’s engagement with French regulators and policymakers. Working closely with EMEA and global legal colleagues, as well as policy and regulatory affairs teams, you will take ownership of assigned French matters, translate complex legal questions into actionable advice and help ensure that our approach in France is consistent with OpenAI’s wider legal positions.

Alongside your primary focus, you will also provide broader French country legal support, coordinating with specialist teams on local business and operational matters.

We’re looking for someone who can take responsibility for matters, give practical advice, manage competing priorities and bring cross-functional work to a decision. You will work closely with EMEA and global legal colleagues, GA and Policy leaders, applying established specialist guidance, approval processes and escalation routes.

In this role, you will:

  • Advise on regulatory developments and their business implications. Assess existing and emerging French and EU laws, enforcement developments and policy proposals affecting OpenAI. Develop legal positions and practical recommendations, working with GA, Policy, Regulatory, Product, Privacy and other legal teams to translate requirements into action. Serve as a trusted legal partner to local leadership and business teams on the establishment, expansion and day-to-day operation of our French presence. Identify legal dependencies early and translate them into practical options and implementation plans.

  • Support regulatory and policy engagement. Serve as a local legal partner on French business and operational matters, including local governance, office development, employment and workplace compliance. jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team and help us run, secure, and scale the infrastructure behind the XTM Platform, Filigran's open-source platform for agentic Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM).

Our customer base keeps growing, in more regions and on more providers, and our platform grows with it: our own bare-metal Kubernetes cloud, the major public clouds, sovereign and regulated environments, and on-premises deployments for customers who run our products themselves.

You'll work across the whole platform, from Kubernetes clusters and deployment tooling to observability, security, and on-call, in a team that has made AI agents a core part of how it works.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate production Kubernetes clusters, on our own bare-metal infrastructure and on public clouds

  • Roll out and operate Filigran products in new regions and on new providers as our SaaS footprint expands

  • Develop and maintain the ways our products get deployed, by us and by our customers: Helm charts (including a major rework of our charts), Ansible automation, CI/CD pipelines, and a virtual appliance for on-premises environments

  • Keep our SaaS instances available and reliable, and continuously improve how we run them: observability, monitoring, capacity planning, incident management, and post-incident reviews

  • Harden the platform and help it meet the requirements of regulated environments (such as FedRAMP and SecNumCloud)

  • Use AI agents throughout your daily work (writing infrastructure code, investigating incidents, drafting runbooks) while staying accountable for everything you review and ship

  • Help design the playground for agents: make our repositories, documentation and guardrails agent-friendly, so other teams can contribute safely, and regularly step back on what works and what needs to improve

  • Take problems from first signal to shipped solution: scope them, propose an approach, and document your decisions so others (humans and agents alike) can build on them

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • You'll report to the Director of Platform Engineering

  • You'll join a collaborative, non-siloed Platform Engineering team of about fifteen people across three verticals, working closely with our Technical Product Manager and fellow platform engineers, including staff engineers

  • You'll work hand in hand with software development teams and customer support on reliability, scalability and the rollout of new products and features

  • On-call: a shared rotation of around one daytime shift and one night shift every two weeks, plus one weekend every six weeks or so. Night and weekend on-call is compensated.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, SRE, DevOps or Cloud Engineer

  • Hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production: operating and troubleshooting clusters, not just deploying to them

  • Strong Ansible skills and experience writing and maintaining Helm charts

  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals

  • Comfortable working on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP…), or strongly willing to learn

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar) and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana…)

  • A security mindset: you think about secrets, access, network exposure and blast radius by default

  • An AI-oriented mindset: you already use AI tools and agents in your work, or you're eager to start, and you review their output with a critical eye

  • Willingness to code: no specific language is required, but you'll read and write scripts and tooling (mostly Python)

  • Comfortable in a remote-first, asynchronous team, with a strong sense of ownership, autonomy and team spirit

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience with bare-metal or on-premises infrastructure, where you handle networking, storage, and the cluster lifecycle yourself

  • Terraform, especially for cloud infrastructure

  • Infrastructure security experience (hardening, software supply chain, vulnerability management) or a CKS certification

  • Experience with regulated or compliance-heavy environments (FedRAMP, SecNumCloud, ISO 27001…)

  • Operating backing services such as Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Redis or S3-compatible storage

  • Hands-on experience designing skills, workflows or guardrails for AI agents

  • Fluent in French

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The Role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free, and told a colleague. The market is open, and we're in the privileged position of clinicians already liking the product. Your job is to turn those smaller-scale use cases into enterprise deals.

You're the first line to Heidi in France. Inbound demand connects you with cabinets, maisons de santé, and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out, or close it yourself. Where the signals run thin, you build the outbound.

For most clinicians, you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. You'll both triage inbound to Account Executives where needed and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across French healthcare that outlasts the role.

What you’ll do

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals across France. Your day goes to clinicians and cabinets already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version.

  • Build outbound where the signals are thin: pick the practice groups, maisons de santé and hospital groups worth going after and work them in French.

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the cabinet or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the case for each one.

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh.

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff.

  • Own SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month.

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get, and so the French-language product and collateral keep up with what you hear.

  • Track what's shifting in French healthcare (regulation, the practice and hospital groups, Assurance Maladie and the mutuelles, the competitive set) and tell the team what you're hearing on the phones.

What you'll need

  • Native or fluent French, and English that allows you to work in a global team.

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, sales, creative, banking, consulting, or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than your time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have extremely busy schedules, so you need to respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Knowing how French healthcare buys (who decides in a cabinet, a maison de santé or a hospital group, and who pays) is a head start. If you don't know it yet, you're the type who'd learn it in your first weeks.

  • Organised and self-running. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. At Heidi, great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude is more important than experience, so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem-solving and building relationships, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

WAIYS ist ein norwegisch-deutsches AI-SaaS-Unternehmen, das fortschrittliche künstliche Intelligenz für die Immobilienbranche praxistauglich macht. Wir starten gerade in eine spannende Scale-up-Phase und suchen eine:n Finance & HR Manager:in mit Hands-on-Mentalität, die unsere zentralen Finanz-, Personal- und Verwaltungsprozesse in beiden Ländern zuverlässig am Laufen hält.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene, strukturierte und pragmatische Person, die gerne die Verantwortung für die tägliche Finanz- und Personaladministration in einem schnell wachsenden internationalen Unternehmen übernimmt.

Deine Mission: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Finanz- und HR-Prozesse in Deutschland und Norwegen korrekt, rechtskonform, gut organisiert und verlässlich geführt werden, mit sauberen Schnittstellen zu unseren externen Buchhaltungs- und Steuerberater:innen.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit dem CFO, dem Management-Team, unseren Mitarbeitenden und externen Berater:innen in Deutschland und Norwegen zusammen. Du verbindest die operative Buchhaltungsvorbereitung mit Lohnabrechnung und Personaladministration, Einkauf und allgemeiner Unternehmensverwaltung.

Die Rolle ist als Teilzeitstelle mit 30 Wochenstunden angelegt. Wenn du zusätzliche Kompetenzen mitbringst, die über die Kernrolle hinaus Mehrwert schaffen, ist auch eine Vollzeitstelle möglich. Das können zum Beispiel Software-Pricing-Management, die Gestaltung von Kontenplänen für internationale SaaS-Strukturen, Compliance und Governance oder CFO-Erfahrung in Norwegen oder Deutschland sein.

Deine Aufgaben

Finanzen & Buchhaltung

  • Du bereitest die laufende Buchhaltung der deutschen Gesellschaft nach HGB vor und übergibst vollständige, saubere Unterlagen an unsere Steuerberatung
  • Du betreust und bereitest Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung, Bankbuchungen, Spesenbelege, Abstimmungen sowie die Unterlagen für Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse vor
  • Du bereitest die Buchhaltung und Finanzadministration unserer norwegischen Gesellschaft vor und stimmst dich eng mit dem CEO sowie unseren norwegischen Buchhaltungs- und Beratungspartnern ab

HR & Lohnabrechnung

  • Du verantwortest die Personaladministration für Mitarbeitende in Deutschland und Norwegen, darunter Verträge, Personalakten, Onboarding, Offboarding, Abwesenheiten und weitere Dokumentation entlang des Employee Lifecycle
  • Du führst die monatliche deutsche Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung in Personio durch, pflegst abrechnungsrelevante Stammdaten und stellst sicher, dass alle Eingaben vollständig, korrekt und aktuell sind
  • Du prüfst die Abrechnungsergebnisse, kümmerst dich um abrechnungsbezogene Rückfragen und bist interne Ansprechperson für administrative HR- und Payroll-Themen; bei Bedarf stimmst du dich mit Behörden und externen Berater:innen ab
  • Du sorgst für eine klare und verlässliche HR-Dokumentation und entwickelst praxisnahe HR-Prozesse mit dem Wachstum des Unternehmens weiter

Administration, Einkauf & Office Operations

  • Du unterstützt die allgemeine Unternehmensverwaltung, das Dokumentenmanagement, die Koordination von Dienstleistern und wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben
  • Du koordinierst Einkauf und Beschaffung, einschließlich Bestellungen, Lieferantenkommunikation, Dokumentation und Rechnungsnachverfolgung
  • Du unterstützt die Verwaltung von Verträgen und Abonnements und trägst dazu bei, interne Verwaltungsprozesse strukturiert und transparent zu halten

Länderübergreifende Zusammenarbeit & Verantwortung

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig für unsere deutsche GmbH und unsere norwegische AS und hältst Finanz-, HR- und Verwaltungsthemen zwischen beiden Gesellschaften abgestimmt
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem CFO, dem Management-Team sowie externen Buchhalter:innen, Steuerberater:innen und weiteren relevanten Partnern zusammen
  • Du erkennst Lücken, verbesserst Routinen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, wiederkehrende Prozesse einfacher, verlässlicher und skalierbar zu gestalten

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Finanzadministration oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Rechnungswesen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der deutschen Buchhaltung und der HGB-Anforderungen sowie die Fähigkeit, die Buchhaltung eigenständig für die Steuerberatung vorzubereiten
  • Praktische Kenntnisse in der deutschen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, mit genug Erfahrung, um Abrechnungsprozesse in einem digitalen Payroll-System sicher zu steuern und zu prüfen
  • Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Sicherheit darin, eigenständig zu arbeiten und dich gleichzeitig eng mit externen Berater:innen und internen Stakeholdern abzustimmen
  • Freude an thematischer Vielfalt, von Buchhaltung und Lohnabrechnung bis hin zu HR, Einkauf und Administration
  • Ausgeprägte digitale Kompetenz und sicherer Umgang mit Buchhaltungs-, HR- und Office-Software sowie Tabellenkalkulation
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Eine pragmatische Denkweise und die Bereitschaft, Prozesse in einem wachsenden Unternehmen aufzubauen und zu verbessern

Ein großes Plus:

  • Erfahrung mit norwegischer Buchhaltung, Lohnabrechnung oder Personaladministration
  • Erfahrung in einem Startup, Scale-up oder einem anderen dynamischen internationalen Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit Personio Payroll oder einem anderen digitalen Payroll-System
  • Erfahrung im Einkauf oder in der allgemeinen kaufmännischen Verwaltung

Was dich bei WAIYS erwartet

Wir sind ein unabhängiges Startup mit viel Raum, um zu wachsen, aufzubauen und von Grund auf mitzugestalten. Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Team, in dem Klarheit, Zusammenarbeit, Eigenverantwortung und praktische Lösungen zählen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Rolle im Zentrum unserer deutsch-norwegischen Unternehmensprozesse
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem CFO, dem Management-Team und externen Finanz- und Steuerberater:innen in Norwegen und Deutschland
  • Eine Teilzeitstelle mit 30 Wochenstunden und flexibel gestaltbaren Arbeitszeiten
  • Die Möglichkeit, die Rolle auf Vollzeit auszubauen, wenn du zusätzliche Kompetenzen mitbringst und weitere Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest
  • Viel Gestaltungsfreiraum, um Finanz-, HR- und Verwaltungsprozesse zu verbessern und sie fit für unser Wachstum zu machen
  • Hybrides/Remote-Arbeiten innerhalb Norwegens oder Deutschlands; wenn du in Dresden lebst, kannst du auch in unserem Büro vor Ort arbeiten
  • Ein internationales Team, das an praxisnaher KI für die Immobilienbranche arbeitet

WAIYS – Simplify AI for Real Estate

jobs.description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io.

About this role:

At Astronomer, we’re redefining how companies run Apache Airflow at scale. Our R&D organization is home to some of the most innovative minds in cloud infrastructure and open-source software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. You get to go in at the ground level of how our production infrastructure is designed, built, tested and deployed. Your work will directly influence how we build Astro, Observe and our IDE product, as well as how global organizations orchestrate data pipelines at scale—making them faster, more reliable, and easier to manage. If you’re driven by impact, excited by scale, and ready to work on the kind of infrastructure challenges that push the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud-native systems, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

What you get to do:

  • Make high-quality, data-driven and experience-driven decisions on how we build this and the next generation of our production platform, then deliver the results.

    • Own and build how we test, build and deploy code in a high-scale PaaS environment.

    • Collaborate across the whole company on how we design production systems, set standards and make technology choices for new and existing products, and how these fit together.

    • Deliver results - we routinely “change the wheels on the bus while it’s moving”, in a predictable, safe and reliable way.

  • Be at the forefront of how we work together as a Platform Engineering team.

    • Blaze a Trail: Work on a small but growing team on building out the Platform/Reliability practice for the company – this role reports directly to the VP of Reliability.

    • Be an Owner: Be directly involved in decision-making on what we work on, as well as how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them.

    • Do Sensible Things: Be directly involved in determining how our platform works. Participate in incident management and determine sensible practices as the platform evolves.

    • Garage Door Open: Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation for systems and processes, ensuring clarity and accessibility.

What you bring to the role:

  • Strong experience in Non-Abstract Systems design and implementation.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, Golang and in-depth experience with Kubernetes (CKA or equivalent or greater).

  • Experience with observability principles and technologies, including SLI/SLO definition and tracking.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in working with a globally distributed team in delivery.

  • A passion for reliability and operational excellence. A low tolerance for toil and other nonsense.

  • Ability to estimate the scope of work accurately and coordinate with stakeholders to address risks and ensure successful project delivery.

  • Experience with (and ideally strong opinions on) software development best practices, such as code review, testing, CI/CD, version control, automation and debugging.

  • Proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues, with a focus on ownership and accountability.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers.

  • Experience with our particular tech stack components and technologies (deep breath): CircleCI, Chronosphere (Prometheus), Splunk, Bazel, Istio, Playwright, Karpenter, Github [Actions] …

  • Experience of the innards and quirks of AWS, GCP and (particularly) Azure.

  • Participated in an on-call rotation - this role involves periodic on-call for the services we own.

  • Experience with Apache Airflow.

At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

Summary

Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in the UK. This team ensures that users can safely browse the web through Menlo's secure cloud — protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorised web applications. The services this team builds are core to Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which puts you at the centre of one of the most active problems in enterprise security right now: how organisations gain visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI usage without blocking it entirely. The team applies AI in how it builds as well — code assistants, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-supported log and incident analysis — so you will be using these tools alongside defending against their misuse.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • Reliable, performant delivery of Threat Protection and ShadowAI services that detect and control risky web and generative AI application usage for Menlo customers.

  • End-to-end ownership of assigned features, from design through production operation and iteration.

Success Metrics / KPIs: (drafted for hiring manager review and adjustment)

  • Service availability and latency for owned components meet or exceed team SLOs.

  • Features delivered on committed roadmap dates, with quality measured by post-release defect and rollback rates.

  • Automated test coverage maintained or improved on owned code paths.

  • Detection accuracy for AI application and malicious site coverage, measured by false positive and false negative rates.

  • Mean time to detect and resolve production issues in owned services.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and own new features and services in the Threat Protection and ShadowAI product area, contributing directly to Menlo's technical roadmap.

  • Build highly available, scalable distributed systems and APIs, including multithreaded and asynchronous applications, with performance and security considered from the start.

  • Build and refine the detection and policy capabilities that give customers visibility into generative AI and unsanctioned web application usage in their environments.

  • Participate in building, deploying, and operating the Menlo Security platform in production, using dashboards, error reporting, metrics, and AI-assisted log and trace analysis to identify and resolve defects quickly.

  • Use AI code assistants and AI-assisted test generation as part of your normal workflow to move faster, while applying your own judgement on correctness, security, and maintainability before anything ships.

  • Partner with product, security, operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align on requirements, tradeoffs, and schedules.

  • Write unit and automated tests, conduct code and design reviews for peers, and evaluate emerging technologies that could improve our products.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • 3-5 years of professional software development experience with one or more of NodeJS, Go, or Python.

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS.

  • Working experience with Linux and standard development tooling such as git.

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field (BE, BTech, or Masters), or equivalent practical experience.

  • Practical fluency with AI coding and debugging assistants, including sound judgement about when to rely on LLM output and when to verify it independently.

  • Self-directed approach to problem solving, with the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems and technologies with limited guidance.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Experience building large-scale web applications and REST APIs.

  • Strong grounding in complex data structures and database technologies.

  • Experience with containers, Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure as code tooling such as Terraform.

  • Familiarity with the Tornado web application framework and test automation.

  • Track record of adapting and improving engineering practices such as test-driven development, continuous delivery, agile ceremonies, automation, and maintainable, testable code.

  • Interest in or exposure to security, threat detection, or AI governance and safety.

     

MSGL-I4

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer - London
jobs.description:
Drata is building the trust layer between great companies - automating compliance, managing risk, and helping organizations prove trust continuously as they scale. We're Dratanauts: a global crew of 600+ professionals united by a culture that rewards integrity, ownership, and raising the bar, no matter where in the world we're working from.

Why Join the Drata Team?
At Drata, you're not maintaining legacy compliance software - you're building the agentic AI platform defining what trust looks like for the next generation of companies. Here's what makes the work itself worth showing up for:

  • Problems without a playbook: You'll work at the edge of AI and security, building agentic governance, continuous compliance, and real-time trust verification to solve problems that don't have an established answer yet. You're writing it as you go.

  • Real ownership, not just process: Our values center on owning outcomes and raising the bar, not checking boxes. You're expected to have opinions and back them.

  • A seat at the table: Your perspective is unique and valued. Open debate and diverse viewpoints are built into how decisions actually get made here, at every level.

  • Growth at rocketship speed: Drata is scaling fast, which means scope grows fast too. High performers get more ownership, visibility, and experience.

  • A crew, not just coworkers: Dratanauts consistently describe a "come as you are" culture with sharp, curious people—the kind of team that makes hard problems genuinely fun to solve. See what they say here and follow us on LinkedIn for company news, employee stories, and career updates.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a motivated, curious, and solutions-driven Sales Engineer with a passion for helping customers solve complex challenges through technology. In this role, you will support the sales and channel team in engaging prospects and customers, demonstrating technical value, and driving successful outcomes. You will play a key role in both new customer acquisition and expanding relationships with existing customers. Measures of success include contribution to deal progression and overall impact on sales team efficiency and success.

This is a hybrid role with the expectation of working in the London office 1-2 days per week.

What you’ll do:

  • Partner with Account Executives to support prospective customers as they evaluate the Drata platform

  • Support technical proof of concepts and demonstrations, helping to simplify the buyer’s journey

  • Align customer pain points and requirements with proposed solutions

  • Develop and deliver compelling product demonstrations and help win new channel partners.

  • Gather and communicate customer needs to product and engineering teams for future enhancements

  • Conduct competitive research to inform positioning and strategy

  • Assist in building financial business cases for prospective customers

  • Manage technical aspects of RFP/RFI responses and documentation

What you’ll bring:

Curiosity

  • A strong desire to understand customer challenges, industry trends, and evolving technologies

  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and solutions

  • Proactive approach to problem-solving, always looking for creative ways to add value

Collaboration

  • Ability to work closely with sales, channel, product, and engineering teams to deliver the best solutions for customers

  • Willingness to share knowledge and contribute to team success

  • A mindset of continuous learning and improvement through feedback and shared experiences

Solutions-Oriented Mindset

  • A proactive approach to identifying challenges and proposing effective solutions

  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business value for customers

  • Strong analytical thinking to support decision-making and sales strategy

Impactful Communication

  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts in an easy-to-understand manner

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for presentations, customer interactions, and internal collaboration

  • Confidence in delivering demonstrations and engaging with stakeholders at all levels

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience as a Sales / Solutions Engineer preferably in the SaaS space.

  • Working knowledge of common cloud providers across tools including:

    • Infrastructure - AWS, GCP, Azure

    • Identity Management - Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID

    • Version Control - GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab

  • Experience running trials and POCs and serving as the technical partner of the prospective customer throughout their evaluation.

  • Solid technical background with understanding and/or hands-on experience in integrating cloud systems and API workflows

  • Ability to creatively explain and present complex concepts in an easy to understand manner

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent presentation and creativity skills

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata.

  • Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, employees and their dependents

  • Financial Well-being: To support your retirement planning, our EOR offers a pension plan under which you contribute 5% of your basic earnings, and your employer contributes an additional 4%, helping you build a more secure financial future.

  • Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

  • Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

  • Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected OTE range for this role is between £126,800 - £156,700 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role.

Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Total compensation may also include equity designed to provide meaningful ownership in the company, as well as health and wellbeing benefits.

jobs.title: Technical Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes.

What you'll do

You’ll join Cytix’s Software Engineering department as our Technical Delivery Manager, helping turn our product roadmap into predictable, high-quality releases.
Following our Series A funding, we’re expanding our engineering team. We’re looking for someone with a technical background who can bring structure to delivery, keep teams aligned and remove the obstacles that slow engineers down.

Reporting to the Co-Founder / CTO, you’ll work with a distributed team of up to ten engineers across Manchester, the wider UK and overseas. This is an individual contributor role with responsibility for coordinating delivery and improving how the team works.

What you'll need

  • Own day-to-day delivery of the agreed roadmap, working with the CTO and engineers to turn priorities into realistic plans and clear milestones.

  • Work with engineers to break down work, assess capacity and understand estimates, making trade-offs and delivery risks visible early.

  • Use your technical understanding to identify dependencies, challenge assumptions constructively and help resolve delivery blockers.

  • Coordinate engineering and QA so testing and release readiness are built into delivery plans.

  • Keep stakeholders informed about progress, risks and decisions needed, with clear reporting that supports action.

  • Act as the delivery point of contact for Customer Success, ensuring customer feedback and requests enter a clear prioritisation process.

  • Keep delivery aligned with company priorities, making the impact of changes to scope or urgency explicit.

  • Establish practical ways of working that support a growing engineering team without adding unnecessary administration.

  • Improve delivery using evidence from completed work, release quality and team feedback.



Success in this role means engineers have clear priorities, blockers are addressed quickly, and stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered and when.
You’ll work on Cytix’s core product, with our Manchester City Centre office as your base.

If you have a Computer Science degree, with 2-3 years experience in a technical environment and / or have worked in a software focused role and looking to pivot into a TDM please reach out.

We're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

 

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

 

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

 

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

 

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

 

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

Compensation: £50K – £65K • + Equity + benefits

jobs.title: Treasury Manager
jobs.description:
• Who we’re looking for: An experienced Treasury Manager with a track record of implementing treasury controls and processes in a scaling FinTech 🚀

  • The challenge: To play a vital role in managing the company's treasury operations, ensuring optimal cash management and financial risk mitigation 🌟

  • Where you’ll work: This role will be based in our Hove Office 2 days a week 🏢

The Tillo Difference

We're in the business of rewards and incentives, so we know a thing or two about the importance of giving back. We can't grow as a business without growing as individuals, so we are committed to providing a workplace where passionate, driven individuals can thrive. We value collaboration, trust, positivity, and a willingness to learn - only by working as a team will we reach our goals.

We’re the market leader in the UK and are active in a number of other markets including USA, Europe, Australia and India. 🌎

Job Summary:

As Tillo continues to scale its global footprint, we are seeking a highly analytical, hands-on Treasury Manager to take immediate ownership of our global cash operations, capital structures, and advanced liquidity forecasting frameworks. Operating within a high-volume fintech ecosystem driven by complex client floats and commercial brand credit mechanics, this high-visibility role requires an exceptional finance professional. You will be responsible for mastering intricate operational fund flows, establishing an airtight daily cash positioning rhythm, and designing rigorous compliance frameworks to optimise our capital structure and support corporate initiatives

Day to day this role will

  • Establish Daily Cash Positioning: Run tight, daily global cash positioning across multiple legal entities and currencies to ensure flawless operational execution and strategic cash movements.

  • Optimise Working Capital: Manage and monitor the delicate balance of client floats and pre-funded brand credit cycles, ensuring daily funding availability without creating operational pinches.

  • Own Rolling Forecasts: Build, maintain, and stress-test robust 13-week and 12-month rolling cash flow models to accurately project working capital needs and corporate funding liquidity.

  • Design and maintain strict treasury controls to track client fund flows, ensuring clear visibility, risk mitigation, and operational segregation between corporate liquidity and client cash.

  • Take full operational ownership of corporate credit facilities, confidently managing drawing mechanics, optimal utilisation, and repayment cycles.

  • Establish and maintain comprehensive financial compliance frameworks, including the proactive calculation of leverage/liquidity ratios and performance tracking against structured internal and external benchmarks.

  • Translate complex treasury positions, liquidity profiles, and capital efficiency metrics into clear, actionable insights directly for the Head of FP&A and the CFO.

  • Act as the lead / super-user for global corporate banking portals, owning user permissions, secure validation controls, and navigating international payment rails (SEPA, ACH, SWIFT).

  • Design and execute corporate foreign exchange (FX) hedging strategies to protect commercial margins against currency volatility as international volume scales.

  • Evaluate, select, and onboard tier-1 global banking partners to support Tillo's expansion into new international markets and currencies.

  • Once daily operations and reporting are thoroughly optimised, evaluate the long-term treasury technology roadmap, including the potential selection and phased implementation of a Treasury Management System (TMS)

What we’re looking for

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive treasury experience, operating as a heavy Individual Contributor or Manager within a private equity backed environment (mid size tier firm)

  • Direct experience in FinTech, payments, marketplaces, or scale-ups where managing highly complex, multi-currency transactional fund flows is a core operational reality.

  • Proven experience hands-on managing corporate financing facilities (e.g., RCFs or revolving credit lines), calculating complex financial covenants, and delivering formal reporting packages.

  • Exceptional financial modelling skills with a proven track record of building and running 13-week rolling cash forecasts and daily cash positioning frameworks from scratch.

  • A strong conceptual and practical understanding of working capital optimisation, specifically dealing with client pre-funding, floats, and commercial vendor credit terms.

  • Deep knowledge of corporate banking platforms, international payment rails (ACH, SEPA, SWIFT), and executing commercial FX hedging strategies.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the confidence to act as a trusted advisor to the CFO and Head of FP&A on critical liquidity and capital decisions

Benefits

Hove:

We offer all our employees trust and empower our team to work with flexibility and autonomy. We’re a close-knit team and love working collaboratively, with our hybrid model, our team can come together at our fantastic office in Hove, but also focus in their own space. The Tillo team are a motivated bunch and we all work hard to push Tillo forwards, always innovating. We completely understand the importance of work/life balance and offer a supportive and collaborative working environment with the following benefits:

  • Enhanced annual leave of 26 days per annum

  • Hybrid Working

  • Anniversary gifts

  • Team Learning & Development budget

About Tillo

Tillo makes gift cards, rewards, and incentives simple, efficient, and profitable. Operating in over 37 markets and 25 currencies, Tillo processes billions in gift card transactions through a single, plug-and-go API, powering rewards and incentives for the world’s leading businesses.

Backed by Tenzing, Tillo is setting the global standard for digital gift card infrastructure.
